settings.title: OpenSprinkler
settings.intro: Connect to the same MQTT broker your OpenSprinkler controller publishes to. The app sends commands over MQTT and listens for status events.
settings.topicPrefixHint: OpenSprinkler's publish topic (Edit Options → MQTT, "pubt"). Status and availability messages arrive under this topic, e.g. opensprinkler or OS-112233AABBCC.
settings.commandTopicHint: OpenSprinkler's subscribe topic ("subt") — where the controller listens for commands. Leave blank to use "<publish topic>/in". On firmware 2.2.1+ this must match the controller exactly (e.g. opensprinkler/in), or commands are ignored.
settings.devicePasswordHint: Your OpenSprinkler web password (default: opendoor). It is MD5-hashed before being sent, never transmitted in plain text.
